text:
deploy-bot: starting config-only rollout by @chris for /chat/generate. change: max_batch_size 10 -> 6, route_timeout 10000ms -> 7000ms, add soft_rate_limit=150r/s. rollout plan: 5% @t0, 30% @t15, 70% @t30, 100% @t45. change window 01:30-03:00 UTC. release: cfg-2026-0316-2. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/config-rollouts

chris: ACK. I'll monitor canary and be ready to pin. tagging SRE and oncall.

maria: enabling extra traces for the route. will watch p95/p99 and cache hitrate.

deploy-bot: progressed to 5% at 01:35 UTC. initial telemetry: p95 +22%, p99 +48%, errors 0.1%.

eva-oncall: noticed higher p99 on two hosts, likely kvcache churn. alert thresholds set: p95 > 1.4x OR error-rate > 0.8% for 5m.

lina: checking logs, seeing kvcache eviction events and some OOM logs for worker process on host-07. Might be related to batch size reduction causing more concurrent KV lookups.

maria: suggestion: for canary only, set max_batch_size=4 and kv_cache_ttl_ms=90000 to reduce pressure. canary hotfix could buy time.

chris: apply hotfix to canary, hold rollout. moving to patch at 01:44 UTC.

deploy-bot: applied canary patch at 01:44 UTC. holding 12m for stabilization.

eva-oncall: after patch, p95 back to +8% and p99 back within +20%. small uptick in 5xxs 0.2% -> 0.4%, investigating traces.

mark: define rollback trigger: sustained errors >1% for 5m OR p99 tail > 2x baseline for 10m. rollback plan: revert to cfg-2026-0315-9 and remove soft_rate_limit changes. Pin command: /run rollback --route /chat/generate --rev cfg-2026-0315-9

lina: 5xx traces point to Tenant_X integration timeouts; adding tenant-level throttling to Tenant_X for canary.

maria: tenant throttle applied, canary looks stable. recommending resume to 30% at 02:00 UTC but keep extra traces for 30m.

chris: resuming to 30% at 02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: reached 30% at 02:02 UTC. metrics: p95 +6%, errors 0.3%.

eva-oncall: noting that error spikes align with Tenant_X bursts only. no wide regressions.

maria: follow-up action: schedule a warmup traffic job for cold cache paths and add per-host cache budget increase in next config cycle. not changing cache size this window.

chris: agreed. moving to 70% at 02:18 UTC as long as next 15m stable.

deploy-bot: progressed to 70% at 02:20 UTC. Observability: p95 +4%, errors 0.35%. No paging.

mark: remind: if any tenant-specific issues recur, prefer tenant throttles or pin traffic to previous rev for affected tenant before a full rollback.

lina: documenting host-07 investigation: root cause likely memory pressure from concurrent KV lookups combined with cache churn. host-07 restarted once during canary patch.

chris: proceeding to 100% at 02:35 UTC after green signal.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 02:36 UTC. final stats: p95 +3%, p99 +12%, error-rate 0.38%. No rollback.

maria: appending notes to release: hotfix applied to canary (max_batch_size=4, kv_cache_ttl_ms=90000), tenant throttle for Tenant_X, follow-ups: warmup job + per-host cache sizing.

chris: closing thread. rollback commands and runbook linked in release notes. thanks team :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: change page: https://internal/changes/cfg-2026-0316-2 - includes rollback steps and pin/unpin commands.
